## What changes

One or two sentences. What was wrong, and what this does about it.

## Checks

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] no comments added (`//`, `///`, `/* */`, `<!-- -->`, `--` in SQL)
- [ ] no em dash anywhere, including this description
- [ ] every new message names the fix, in lowercase, with commands in backticks
- [ ] new behaviour is covered by a test that fails without the change

Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) if any of those are new to you.
